name: 21476-batchdecode-nemotronnano9b-1gpu
model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-FP8 -- ungated, ~9.6 GiB. Do not substitute the bf16 sibling or a differently quantized checkpoint.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: NemotronHForCausalLM, 8.89B parameters, modelopt FP8. 56 layers resolving to 27 recurrent, 4 self-attention and 25 MLP blocks; hidden 4480, intermediate 15680, vocab 131072, max_position_embeddings 131072. Recurrent state is a fixed 136.9 MiB per request; the four attention layers hold 16.0 KiB of bf16 KV per token over the whole model.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: ~1024 prompt tokens (stdev 128, clamped to [512, 1536]) against exactly 512 generated, `output_tokens_stdev: 0`, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42. A 1:2 ratio, so the run is decode-dominant.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on one GPU, serving 32 concurrent users nine-billion-parameter drafts from page-length prompts.
launch:
# sglang at commit 013fa5563022f921e0e2f634a946cbcecbc082b2
# (`git describe --tags` = gateway-v0.3.1-2229-g013fa556302).
#
# FLAT PARSER: `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. An indented block is skipped
# silently, so every value has to stay on a single line or the engine starts without the key.

model-path: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-FP8
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# What the engine's own auto-selector reaches on a Hopper card for this architecture anyway.
# The triton backend is refused outright here: the model's first layer is not an attention layer.
attention-backend: fa3

# Longest request is 1536 + 512 tokens, against a checkpoint declaring 131072. Pinned at twice
# the worst case, which also fixes the engine's request-count estimate instead of deriving it
# from whatever memory happened to be free.
context-length: 4096

# 32 streams ever arrive. 48 also sits under the engine's own recurrent-state request ceiling,
# which lands near 65 on this card at 136.9 MiB of fixed state per request -- do not raise it
# without redoing that arithmetic.
max-running-requests: 48

# Pinned to the admission cap: the run is decode-dominant, and a batch above the capture ladder
# runs eagerly, which is a different measurement.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 48

# No request exceeds 1536 prompt tokens, so nothing is ever split; written down so admission does
# not depend on what the engine computes about free memory.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

random-seed: 42
